name: Atmospheric Scattering Post-Process
definition: A post-processing technique that renders volumetric atmospheric scattering (Rayleigh, Mie, and Ozone absorption) over a scene by tracing rays through a spherical atmosphere shell, accounting for occlusion by scene geometry.
summary: Atmospheric Scattering Post-Process renders volumetric atmospheric effects over the final screen buffer using depth maps, distinguishing itself from in-scene rendering by operating on the completed image.
